description: Vogue Paris issues from one season of one year (spring = March-May, summer = June-August, autumn = September-November, winter = December and the January-February after it), with covers as images for 1930 and earlier. The Paris collections were shown in spring and autumn, so those issues carry the new season's fashions. Example questions: "what was in fashion in spring 1925"; "Vogue's autumn 1928 collections"; "winter 1922 Vogue".

year.description: The year (for winter, the year its December falls in)
